section.content: The utility model discloses a biological gene detection device, which belongs to the technical field of biological gene detection and comprises a storage box, wherein a lifting plate is arranged in the storage box, a first sliding groove is formed in the top of the lifting plate, two first sliding blocks are connected to the inner wall of the first sliding groove in a sliding manner, the tops of the two first sliding blocks are respectively connected with the bottoms of two clamping plates, and the inner walls of the two first sliding blocks are in threaded connection with the outer wall of the same bidirectional screw rod. This biological gene detection utensil is through setting up grip block, two-way lead screw, first motor, second motor, gear and lifter for this detection utensil is fixed at the loading board of using, thereby avoids appearing rocking the condition that leads to the culture dish to appear damaging at the in-process that removes, can go up and down the position of culture dish simultaneously, at the in-process that detects, conveniently shifts out the culture dish and detects, after the detection, can move the culture dish down and protect.

本实用新型公开了一种生物基因检测器具，属于生物基因检测技术领域，其包括储存箱，所述储存箱内设置有升降板，所述升降板的顶部开设有第一滑槽，所述第一滑槽的内壁滑动连接有两个第一滑块，两个第一滑块的顶部分别与两个夹持板的底部相连接，两个第一滑块的内壁与同一个双向丝杆的外壁螺纹连接。该生物基因检测器具，通过设置夹持板、双向丝杆、第一电机、第二电机、齿轮和升降杆，使得该检测器具在使用的过程中，可以将储存培养皿的承载板进行固定，从而避免在移动的过程中出现晃动导致培养皿出现损坏的情况，同时可以对培养皿的位置进行升降，在检测的过程中，方便将培养皿移出进行检测，检测完成后，可以将培养皿下移进行防护。

Biological gene detection instrumentTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of biological gene detection, and particularly relates to a biological gene detection device.

Background

With the implementation of the human genome project and the rapid development of molecular biology-related disciplines, more and more animal, plant and microorganism genome sequences are being determined, and the gene sequence data is rapidly increasing at an unprecedented rate. In order to study the functions of many genes in life, a novel hybridization and sequencing method and device must be established to detect and analyze a large amount of genetic information efficiently and rapidly, and in order to meet the scientific development requirements, in combination with the interdisciplinary disciplines of microelectronics, physics, chemistry, material science, life science, etc., a gene chip is researched, and after a large number of probe molecules are immobilized on a solid carrier support according to a specific arrangement manner, complementary matching hybridization is performed on the labeled detected gene sample molecules, and the number and sequence information of the sample molecules are obtained by detecting the hybridization signal intensity of each probe molecule.

Chinese patent discloses a biological gene detection utensil, and the bulletin number is CN208440604U, puts forward "including base station, a plurality of transparent piece and transparent lid herein, the culture chamber has been seted up to the base station, the culture chamber has an opening, a plurality of culture tanks have been seted up to the bottom of culture chamber, each the sampling slot has been seted up to the lateral wall of culture tank, each the transparent piece activity set up in one in the culture tank, each the transparent piece has relative first side and the second side that sets up, the transparent piece has the third side with first side adjacently, first side with the second side respectively the butt in the lateral wall of culture tank", current detection utensil is usually through the culture dish storage sample detect, but the in-process of culture dish removal lacks safeguard measure to lead to the condition that the damage appears in the culture dish easily, and then influence biological gene's detection process.

Disclosure of utility model

In order to overcome the defects in the prior art, the utility model provides a biological gene detection device, which solves the problems that the conventional detection device usually stores a specimen through a culture dish for detection, but the culture dish lacks protection measures in the moving process, so that the damage condition of the culture dish is easy to occur and the biological gene detection process is influenced.

The biological gene detection device comprises a storage box, wherein a lifting plate is arranged in the storage box, a first sliding groove is formed in the top of the lifting plate, two first sliding blocks are connected to the inner wall of the first sliding groove in a sliding mode, the tops of the two first sliding blocks are respectively connected with the bottoms of two clamping plates, the inner wall of the two first sliding blocks is in threaded connection with the outer wall of the same bidirectional screw rod, one end of the bidirectional screw rod is in transmission connection with the output end of a first motor, the side face of the first motor is fixedly connected with one side corresponding to the lifting plate, two mounting seats are fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the storage box, a second motor is fixedly connected to the tops of the two mounting seats, transmission rods are connected to the two ends of the second motor in a transmission mode, gears are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the transmission rods, the bottom of the lifting plate is connected with the top of a supporting plate, lifting rods are arranged at the bottom of the supporting plate, a plurality of tooth grooves are formed in the outer wall of the lifting rods, and the lifting rods are meshed with the gears through tooth grooves.

As a further scheme of the utility model, the top of the lifting plate is provided with a bearing plate, the top of the bearing plate is provided with a plurality of placing grooves, and culture dishes are arranged in the placing grooves.

As a further scheme of the utility model, the two ends of the inner wall of the storage box are respectively provided with a second sliding groove, the inner walls of the two second sliding grooves are respectively connected with a second sliding block in a sliding way, and the inner walls of the second sliding grooves and the outer walls of the second sliding blocks are respectively subjected to polishing treatment.

As a further scheme of the utility model, one ends of the two second sliding blocks, which are opposite, are respectively connected with one ends of the two baffle plates, which are far away from each other, and one ends of the two baffle plates, which are opposite, are connected with two ends of the same lifting plate.

As a further scheme of the utility model, the bottom of the inner wall of the storage box is fixedly connected with four guide cylinders, the lifting rod is movably connected in the guide cylinders, and the outer wall of the guide cylinder is provided with a through groove.

As a further scheme of the utility model, the top of the storage box is movably connected with a box cover, and the top of the box cover is fixedly connected with a handle.

As a further scheme of the utility model, a top plate is arranged in the box cover, four electric telescopic rods are fixedly connected to the bottom of the top plate, the output ends of the four electric telescopic rods are fixedly connected with the top of the same connecting plate, and a plurality of sealing covers are arranged at the bottom of the connecting plate.

As a further scheme of the utility model, the bottom of the storage box is fixedly connected with four universal wheels, the four universal wheels are distributed at four corners of the bottom of the storage box, and brake pads are arranged in the universal wheels.

The working principle and the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows:

1. This biological gene detection utensil, through setting up the lifter plate, the grip block, two-way lead screw, first motor, the second motor, gear and lifter, when using, place the loading board on the lifter plate earlier, then start first motor, first motor rotates and drives two-way lead screw rotation, because two-way lead screw adopts threaded connection with two first sliders, can drive two first sliders relative motion, thereby drive two grip blocks relative motion, can fix the loading board, then start the second motor, the second motor drives the transfer line and rotates, thereby drive the gear and rotate, thereby drive the lifter and go up and down, thereby drive the loading board and go up and down, make this detection utensil in the in-process of using, can fix the loading board of storing the culture dish, thereby avoid appearing rocking the condition that leads to the culture dish to appear damaging at the in-process of removal, simultaneously can go up and down the position of culture dish, at the in-process of detecting, conveniently shift out the culture dish and detect, after the detection is accomplished, can move the culture dish down and protect.

2. This biological gene detection utensil through setting up roof, electric telescopic handle, connecting plate and sealed lid, after the fixed completion of culture dish, starts electric telescopic handle, electric telescopic handle drives connecting plate and sealed lid and moves down for sealed lid cup joints the culture dish, can seal the culture dish, makes this detection utensil when using, can seal the culture dish, thereby reduce with external contact, guarantee that the sample in the culture dish is not polluted, simultaneously through multiunit spaced culture dish, can avoid the condition that the mutual influence appears in the sample that awaits measuring of difference.

All other embodiments, which can be made by one of ordinary skill in the art based on the embodiments of the utility model without making any inventive effort, are intended to be within the scope of the utility model.

The working principle of the utility model is as follows:

When the lifting plate is used, the bearing plate 13 is placed on the lifting plate 2, the first motor 7 is started, the first motor 7 rotates to drive the bidirectional screw rod 6 to rotate, the bidirectional screw rod 6 and the two first sliding blocks 4 are in threaded connection, the two first sliding blocks 4 can be driven to move relatively, the two clamping plates 5 can be driven to move relatively, the bearing plate 13 can be fixed, after the culture plate 15 is fixed, the electric telescopic rod 23 is started, the electric telescopic rod 23 drives the connecting plate 24 and the sealing cover 25 to move downwards, the sealing cover 25 is used for sleeving the culture plate 15, the culture plate 15 can be sealed, the second motor 9 is started, the second motor 9 drives the transmission rod 10 to rotate, the gear 11 is driven to rotate, the gear 11 drives the lifting rod 12 to lift, and the bearing plate 13 is driven to lift.

The foregoing description of the preferred embodiments of the utility model is not intended to limit the utility model to the precise form disclosed, and is intended to cover all modifications, equivalents, alternatives, and alternatives falling within the spirit and scope of the utility model.
